Application Data.NAME: St. John's Community Church
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: St. John's Community Church offers a range of services and activities including weekly worship services, community outreach programs, and family support services. We host various events such as holiday celebrations, charitable fundraisers, and youth gatherings. The church also provides a space for community meetings and educational workshops. We prioritize safety and adhere to local health and safety regulations to ensure a welcoming and secure environment for all attendees.

The church settled the claim for $5,000. The claim was closed on April 10, 2023, and was resolved without litigation.

Key Risk Considerations
When underwriting churches and religious organizations, the follow-
ing risk factors require careful evaluation:
• Liability exposures: Group gatherings and community events can lead to slip-and-fall
incidents, crowd control issues, and potential claims arising from alleged negligence. Special
attention should be paid to the presence of alcohol, use of volunteers, and security protocols.
• Property risks: Older buildings may have outdated electrical systems or heating sources
that increase fire risk. Theft and vandalism are also concerns, especially for organizations
located in urban or high-crime areas.
• Food service risks: Even limited cooking can introduce risks of fire, foodborne illness,
and equipment breakdown. Compliance with local health codes and fire safety regulations is
essential.
